harnessOverlay.scope: Added identically to both sources for final guardrails only. Existing resize labels, options and operations unchanged.

stageNotes.initialAttributeOnly: Iteration 1; behavioral red to green, target threshold failed.
stageNotes.snapshotCandidate: Iteration 3; initial pass rejected after isolated repeat.
stageNotes.guardrails: Intermediate iteration 3 only; not final qualification.
stageNotes.isolatedUnselected: Iteration 3 filtered repeat; target threshold failed.
stageNotes.finalGuardrails: Final iteration 5; all 14 guardrails and 2 added phase diagnostics qualify.

limitations: Local M5 qualification, not hosted CI or a general application speedup.

Source-series drift exceeds 5% in some repeated captures; every series range is retained. Filtered resize recaptures isolate the workload and compare against the lowest median of the retained original and filtered baseline series.

The alternating resize median mixes growth and shrink distributions. Supplemental directional diagnostics preserve the JSX path but use different reset timing and cannot replace the unchanged toggle gate.
Final source hashes and runtimeDiff describe only iteration 5, not historical candidates. Intermediate source snapshots are retained separately.
